deadline.value: Apply online by 27 October 2026, 16:00 CET; referees must submit references by 2 November 2026.

also.quote: References must be submitted by your referees by the reference deadline (Monday, 2 November 2026, 23:59 CET).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need to contact faculty first; you can list preferred mentors, and each fellow is co-supervised by two PIs from different fields.
supervisor.quote: No, it is not a requirement to contact faculty members before applying.

funding.value: Fellows get a fully funded 100% ETH employment contract (CHF 73,100 in year one, rising to CHF 83,500).
funding.quote: Yes. ETH AI Center Fellows receive a fully-funded, 100% full-time employment contract at standard ETH Zurich salary rates.

entry_route.value: You need a Master's (CS, ML, statistics, physics, engineering, applied maths or similar) completed at least 3 months before the start, by June 2027 at the latest.
entry_route.quote: You are expected to have completed or will complete a Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, physics, engineering, applied mathematics, or other relevant fields, at least 3 months before the beginning of the fellowship program (latest by June 2027).

notes: 8-12 fully funded doctoral fellowships a year in interdisciplinary AI; shortlisted candidates attend an online symposium on 1-2 February 2027 and offers go out by end of March 2027.
name: ETH AI Center Doctoral Fellowships
